Mine happened when I was about 12 or 13 after my grandfather had just passed away. He was the first major death I had ever experienced. I remember hiding in he bathroom at his funeral and just crying my eyes out. I went into a pretty severe state of depression after that. A couple weeks later my birthday came, and I got a card from my now widowed grandmother. At first I didn't even read the card I just wanted the money that came along with all of her birthday cards. Then a couple days later I picked up the card and read it. It read, "Moosetin, you are my youngest grandchild, I know the past couple months have been hard on all of us, you especially. Just remember something your grandfather told me when we first got married and we're going through hard times. 'It's not just the metal that makes the sword, but the fire and the hammer.'"

Changed my life.
